changes.text: 崇厚与俄国定约后，朝议久争不决。左宗棠上奏逐条指出界务、商务两处不可许，给出议论与战阵两步的方案，自请出屯哈密。一份谈砸的协议面前，光说反对不够，还得说清哪几条不能让、以及凭什么再谈。

After Chong Hou concluded a treaty with Russia, the court debated it at length without reaching a decision. Zuo Zongtang's memorial put the objection into items — the border terms and the trade terms, each marked as unacceptable — set out a two-stage plan of negotiation followed by battle, and volunteered to take command at Hami. Faced with a badly negotiated agreement, opposing it is not enough: you have to say which clauses cannot move, and what stands behind your demand to talk again.
一份由全权大臣在国外谈成的条约送回朝廷，为朝士所纠，议了很久，议不出结果。作者的一种解释是：难处不在于要不要伊犁，而在于约已经签了；认账，是失地失利权在先；翻案，得有人去谈，还得有让对方重新坐下来的筹码。

A treaty negotiated abroad by a plenipotentiary envoy had been sent home to the capital. It was denounced by court officials, and the debate dragged on toward no conclusion. One reading, the author's, is that the trouble was never whether Ili mattered, but that the treaty had already been signed. Accept it, and the lost territory and compromised rights stood as a fait accompli. Repudiate it, and someone had to go back to the table carrying enough leverage to make the other side sit down again.
先看这份奏疏落在什么样的局面里。帕夏能役使回众，通使结援英、俄，购买兵械自备；英人暗中相助，想让他别立一国，用以屏障俄国。俄方则以回众屡扰边境为由，出兵逐回，占了伊犁，还说要代取乌鲁木齐。

Start with the situation the memorial landed in. The Pasha could command the Muslim population, sent envoys to seek support from Britain and Russia, and bought weapons to arm his own forces. The British backed him quietly, hoping to see him set up a separate state that would stand as a shield against Russia. Russia, for its part, cited repeated raids against its border, sent troops to drive the raiders out, seized Ili, and announced that it would go on to take Urumqi on China's behalf.
伊犁之变后，朝廷诏左宗棠分兵屯肃州，他遣徐占彪带六千人前往。传中另记一事：俄方与土耳其交战时，金顺请求乘虚袭击伊犁，左宗棠不许，说「不可。師不以正，彼有辭矣」。

After the Ili crisis, the court ordered Zuo Zongtang to detach troops to garrison Suzhou, and he sent Xu Zhanbiao with six thousand men. The biography records a separate episode: when Russia was at war with Turkey, Jin Shun asked to exploit the opening and strike Ili. Zuo refused: "No. If our army does not act from a position of right, we hand them their excuse."
四年正月，他条上新疆建行省事宜，并请与俄国议两件事：还伊犁、交叛人。朝廷诏遣全权大臣崇厚使俄。

In the first month of the fourth year, he submitted a plan for turning Xinjiang into a regular province, and asked the court to negotiate two matters with Russia: the return of Ili, and the surrender of the defectors. The court sent Chong Hou, a plenipotentiary, to Russia.
俄方开出通商、分界、偿款三项条件，崇厚在俄定约，动作很快——史书用一个「遽」字：「崇厚遽定約」。约成之后为朝士所纠，朝廷议论长久不能决定。条约是签了，却为朝士所纠，议久不决，事情悬在半空。

The Russian side laid out three heads of demand: trade, borders, and indemnity. Chong Hou concluded the treaty on the spot, and he moved fast — the history reaches for one blunt word: "Chong Hou hastily concluded the treaty." Once the treaty existed, the court officials impeached it, and the debate went on without decision. The treaty had been signed, yet court officials denounced it and the debate stalled; the whole affair hung in mid-air.
然后是界务。崇厚又议将陬尔果斯河、帖克斯河一带给俄国，等于划伊犁西南之地归俄。奏中说：「武事不競之秋，有割地求和者矣。茲一矢未加，遽捐要地，此界務之不可許者也」——一仗没打，先捐要地，这是不可许的第一条。

Next, the border. Chong Hou had further proposed to hand Russia the country around the Chorgos and Tekes rivers, which amounted to cutting away the land southwest of Ili. The memorial pressed the point: "In an age when our arms are not strong, there have been those who carved up territory to buy peace. Here, without a single arrow loosed, we would cast away a vital place — this is the border term that cannot be accepted." Not one battle fought, and the key ground surrendered first.
奏中还点破对方的算计：「臣維俄人包藏禍心，妄忖吾國或厭用兵，遂以全權之使臣牽制疆臣」——俄方妄自揣度我方或厌用兵，便用一位全权使臣把疆臣的手捆住。

The memorial also named the calculation on the other side: "I observe that the Russians harbor ill intent, presuming that our country may be weary of war, and so they use a fully empowered envoy to bind the hands of the frontier commander." They had wrongly presumed us tired of fighting, and turned a plenipotentiary into a leash on the man in the field.
既然对方妄忖我方厌战，对策就要把两头都摆出来：「先之以議論，委婉而用機，次決之以戰陣，堅忍而求勝」，末了又说「臣雖衰慵無似，敢不勉旃」。议论与战阵不是二选一，是有先后的两步。

If the Russians had wrongly presumed we were weary of war, the answer had to put both options on the table at once: "first take the matter up in negotiation, tactful and alert to opportunity, then settle it on the field of battle, patient and set on victory" — closing with "Though I am old, tired, and of no great ability, how dare I not do my best." Negotiation and battle were not alternatives to choose between; they were two steps in a fixed order.
奏上，上壮其言，嘉许之，崇厚得罪去，命曾纪泽使俄更前约。于是左宗棠自请出屯哈密，规复伊犁：金顺出精河为东路，张曜沿特克斯河为中路，锦棠经布鲁特游牧为西路，谭上连等分屯喀什噶尔、阿克苏、哈密为后路声援，合马步卒四万余人——原文只记这一合计数，未记实际投入兵力。

The memorial went up. The throne found the words stirring and commended them; Chong Hou was punished and dismissed, and Zeng Jize was sent to Russia to revise the earlier treaty. Thereupon Zuo volunteered to take the field at Hami and plan the recovery of Ili: Jin Shun would advance on Jinghe as the eastern column, Zhang Yao along the Tekes as the central column, and Jintang through the Burut grazing lands as the western column, while Tan Shanglian and others garrisoned Kashgar, Aksu, and Hami in support along the line of communications — more than forty thousand cavalry and infantry all told. The source gives only this combined figure and does not record how many troops were actually committed.
六年四月，宗棠輿櫬發肅州，五月抵哈密。俄方闻王师大出，增兵守伊犁、纳林河，另派兵船在海上出没，用以震撼京师，天津、奉天、山东同时告警。谈判桌之外，两边都在调动。

In the fourth month of the sixth year Zuo set out from Suzhou with a coffin in his carriage, and reached Hami in the fifth. Hearing that the imperial army was moving in force, Russia reinforced Ili and the Nalin River and sent warships cruising off the coast to shake the capital; at the same time Tianjin, Fengtian, and Shandong all raised the alarm. Away from the negotiating table, both sides were moving troops.
至于成败，史书记了和议成、交还伊犁；在此之前另称「俄亦懾我兵威，恐事遂決裂」，但这与和议成只是并置叙述。史书没有记曾纪泽改约的具体内容，也没有把结果归在某一个人名下。把这段读成主战就对、主和就错的教训，超出了材料能说的话。

As for success and failure, the history records that peace was concluded and Ili returned; just before that, it says that Russia, too, was awed by our military might and feared an outright rupture, but this is merely set alongside the conclusion of peace. It gives no substance for Zeng Jize's revision of the treaty, and it does not attach the outcome to any one man's name. To read this episode as a lesson that the war party was right and the peace party wrong goes beyond what the material can support.
本文只有一个史源，即《清史稿·左宗棠传》，成书在传主身后，所述与当时档案未必一致。奏疏与对话（如「先之以議論」「師不以正」）是史书的记述，未必是逐字原话。英文版引号内的文字是作者对古文的译述。

This piece rests on a single source, the biography of Zuo Zongtang in the Draft History of the Qing, compiled after his death; its account may not match the archives of the time. The memorial and the dialogue — such as "first take the matter up in negotiation" and "our army does not act from a position of right" — are the history's rendering and may not be verbatim. Quoted passages in English are the author's translations of the classical Chinese.

dispositions.rationale: 英文删去无据的“for months”，改为“debated it at length without reaching a decision”，与原文「議久不決」及中文「久争不决」一致；中文未改，按同步规则一并给出。
中文「纷纷纠弹」改为「为朝士所纠」，英文改为“It was denounced by court officials”，去掉原文没有的接连、众多之意。
利害分析一句前加「作者的一种解释是」/“One reading, the author's, is that”，明确标为作者解释，不再当作记录叙述。
英文改为“sent envoys to seek support from Britain and Russia”，补回「结援」中的求援之意；中文未改，一并给出。
改为“传中另记一事：俄方与土耳其交战时……”/“The biography records a separate episode: when…”，把两事分开叙述，不暗示二者同时。证据没有交代两事的先后，所以也不写“后来”。
删去「于是」/“accordingly”，只陈述朝廷诏遣崇厚使俄这件事，不断言它与左宗棠的请求有因果关系。

evidence.quote: 並請與俄議還伊犁、交叛人二事
詔遣全權大臣崇厚使俄

dispositions.rationale: 删去签约人合法性被否定的说法，改为条约为朝士所纠、议久不决，中英文同步。

evidence.quote: 崇厚遽定約，為朝士所糾，議久不決

dispositions.rationale: 「议定把」改为「议将」，英文改为“had further proposed to hand”，按「議畀」表达议欲给予，不写成已成定案。

evidence.quote: 今崇厚又議畀俄陬爾果斯河及帖克斯河

dispositions.rationale: 改为「既然对方妄忖我方厌战」/“If the Russians had wrongly presumed we were weary of war”，不再暗示俄方判断正确。
「同时」改为「于是」，英文“At the same time”改为“Thereupon”，与原文「於是」一致。

evidence.quote: 於是宗棠乃自請出屯哈密

dispositions.rationale: 删去关于实际开战兵力的断言，改为原文只记这一合计数、未记实际投入兵力，中英文同步。
中文补入「用以震撼京师」，与英文“to shake the capital”及原文一致；英文未改，一并给出。

evidence.quote: 別以兵船翔海上，用震撼京師

dispositions.rationale: 删去“只记”的说法，补述史书另称俄亦慑我兵威、恐事决裂，并说明这与和议成只是并置叙述，因果未经证实；英文用译述，不加引号。

evidence.quote: 而俄亦懾我兵威，恐事遂決裂

dispositions.rationale: 古文引语改为与证据逐字一致的繁体：「先之以議論」「師不以正」。
英文加入“Quoted passages in English are the author's translations of the classical Chinese.”，中文相应说明英文版引号内的文字是作者对古文的译述，两种语言保持一致。
转述改为「俄方妄自揣度我方或厌用兵」，英文改为“They had wrongly presumed us tired of fighting”，保留「妄」字的意思。
